answer: Graph-distance bond: violet pigment dyes each identity in the referral graph; a vouch spreads it one hop. New identities need distance three from their operator's others; a shared pigment flags one operator. A gale audit re-samples a tenth of edges each epoch; forgery slashes the bond and fines rented referrers. First identity costs 45 credits, the k-th 45+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,541,500 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once.
